kota: Cap Classique works because its crisp acidity and bubbles cut through the richness of chips, cheese, Russian sausage and sauces, refreshing the palate after every bite.
bobotie: Chenin Blanc balances the sweet and savoury flavours of Bobotie while complementing the aromatic Cape Malay spices and fruit notes often found in the dish.
umngqusho: Merlot's soft tannins and ripe fruit character complement the nutty flavours of samp and beans without overpowering this traditional Xhosa favourite.
shisa nyama meat: Cabernet Sauvignon matches the smoky grilled flavours of Shisa Nyama. Its structure and dark fruit flavours stand up beautifully to fire-cooked meat.
bunny chow: Riesling's freshness and slight sweetness help cool the spice of Durban curry while enhancing the aromatic flavours of the dish.
malva pudding: Muscadel mirrors the caramel and apricot notes of Malva Pudding, creating a rich and indulgent dessert pairing.
snoek: Sauvignon Blanc brings bright citrus and freshness that complements the smoky, slightly sweet flavours of braaied snoek.
mogodu: Pinotage's earthy character pairs naturally with the rich savoury flavours of tripe while providing enough fruit to keep the pairing balanced.
boerewors: Pinotage is South Africa's signature red and naturally complements the smoky spices and juicy character of traditional boerewors.
potjiekos: Merlot's smooth texture and dark fruit flavours complement the slow-cooked richness of Potjiekos without overwhelming the dish.
